method.actual_token_offsets: Load the pinned CT tokenizer.json with tokenizers.Tokenizer. For each of the 200 actual run_command rows, encode existing prompt+completion with add_special_tokens=False and require IDs equal archived input_ids. Intersect exact character spans with actual assistant_loss_mask. No chat-template prefix is regenerated and no IDs/masks are modified.
method.command_binding: Strict-parse completion to command, locate exact literal command within native completion, then require equality with actual messages tool_call_id arguments. All source messages SHA checked against each row. Actual response stdout/stderr/exit are taken from CommandError.details when present, otherwise top-level; raw response content SHA is retained.
method.pure_record_span_definition: AST Expr(Call(Name(print),...)) whose first constant argument is source_binding/workspace import:/dependency_binding, plus exact print(m.__name__, p). Span is the full physical source line including indentation and newline; no line is shared with a behavior statement. This is a conservative record-only code subset, not all provenance costs.
method.binding_envelope_definition: Initial contiguous Python-body prefix through final source metadata print or source identity Assert (__file__, is_relative_to, actual==expected or a==e). Imports in that prefix may also serve domain code; the envelope is explicitly not classified as removable.
method.span_convention: Half-open Python Unicode character indices in exact command string; command_span_in_completion is half-open in actual completion. CT tokenizer offsets are in existing prompt+completion; absolute span offset is len(prompt)+command_span_in_completion[0]+command-relative span. Fully-contained token count is the conservative result; intersecting count also reported. All reported boundaries happened to have no crossing tokens.
method.partition: For each command, native serialization + Python heredoc wrapper + initial source-binding envelope + remaining body equals all selected targets. Pure provenance prints are a nested subset of source-binding envelope, never added again.
method.independent_read_only_review: A separate agent inspected 7 tasks/14 canonical messages and source bindings (81,82,88,8,12,56,95); no commands or oracle were executed.
